Can I reroute the package to a different address?
Once an order has shipped, we cannot reroute or update the delivery address ourselves.
If your package is already in transit, we recommend reaching out directly to the carrier (UPS, FedEx, or USPS) with your tracking number to see if they can intercept or reroute the package for you.
